title: John Calvin
source: Public domain. Consolidated from John Calvin, Commentaries on the Catholic Epistles, translated by John Owen, Calvin Translation Society, and the Institutes of the Christian Religion, translated by Henry Beveridge; both as published by the Christian Classics Ethereal Library.
body: John Calvin on Second Peter, chapter 3. In his Commentaries on the Catholic Epistles, in the John Owen translation, Calvin writes at Second Peter 3, verse 1: Lest they should be wearied with the Second Epistle as though the first was sufficient, he says that it was not written in vain, because they stood in need of being often stirred up. In the Institutes of the Christian Religion, in the Henry Beveridge translation, Calvin draws on this chapter again in Book 3, chapter 2.
